title: GTA 6 PS5 Crash CE-108255-1: Check This First

beats.say: Why is your PS5 crashing in GTA 6? Before you reinstall, check this one error code.
beats.screen: Phone photo of the PS5 crash screen

beats.say: If it says CE-108255-1, that is the code being reported on some PS5s since launch.
beats.screen: Zoom on the error code, circled

beats.say: So you are not the only one, and it is not just your console.
beats.screen: Screenshot montage of forum posts with the same code (blur usernames)

beats.say: [FILL: the exact fix that worked for YOU, step by step. Only post a fix you tested.]
beats.screen: Screen recording of the settings menu, each step on screen

beats.say: That is the fix. Check the code first, try that, and only reinstall if it still crashes.
beats.screen: Game running cleanly past the point it used to crash

beats.say: Comment your error code if it is a different one.
